sentences.text: As per prosecution story, present appellant provoked prosecutrix to perform her marriage with some other person and thereafter she alongwith other co-accused persons helped to sold the prosecutrix to co-accused Balram on consideration of Rs. 1.80 lakhs.
Thereafter co-accused Balram repeatedly committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
Accordingly, offence has been registered against the appellant.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is an innocent person and she has been falsely implicated in this offence.

She is in custody s inc e 17.01.2023, investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed, appellant is permanent resident of District Ratlam and her movable &
immovable property is also situated there.
The appellant is not the main accused.

Co-accused Pooja,
Deepa Parmar, Sahida Bee and Farida have been enlarged on bail by this court vide orders dated 12.03.2023, 12.03.2023 and 13.3.2023 passed in Cri.A. Nos. 4267 of 2023, 4558 of 2023 and 2269 of 2023 i n similar circumstances but final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the criminal appeal and prays for its rejection.
Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence, and also taking note of the fact that present appellant is not the main accused, she has attributed limited role in said offence, she is 25 years old lady and not having criminal past, investigation is over therefore, no further custodial interrogation of appellant is required, co-accused Pooja, Deepa Parmar, Sahida Bee and Farida have been enlarged on bail in similar circumstances, final conclusion of the trial will take sufficient long time, I deem it proper to release the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed.

It is directed that appellant be released on bail on her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for her appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

She shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3)
of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
